api_lessons: Entry points by script type: Macro -> main(doc); Tool -> buildUI(tool); Polygonobj/Splineobj -> buildUI(obj) and buildObject(obj); Tag -> buildUI(tag).

api_lessons: Per-frame export pattern: loop doc.setAnimPosition(frame/fps) (time in seconds) then doc.saveToFile(path, 'obj') for each frame.

Cheetah 6.2.1 on Mavericks. 2020 user still asking for a working importer for 6.3.3 (no answer).

api_lessons: To sample animation, step doc.setAnimPosition(t) with t in seconds (dt = 1/frameRate) and re-read obj.obj2WorldMatrix()/getParameter each step.
getParameter('rotation') returns a vector with h, p, b fields; new Mat4D(ROTATE_HPB, h, p, b) builds the rotation matrix.
A camera's default view direction is (0,0,-1); rotate it by the HPB matrix to get the view vector.
File output: new File(path); file.open(WRITE_MODE); file.writeln(...); file.close().
notes: Script hardcodes 30 fps / 30 frames; untested with parented objects. Points to tg_jp's Radium and Sunflow exporter scripts as references.

title: Position of object in animation frame
summary: Q&A: two macros to read an object's position at a given time (via setAnimPosition or F-curves).

evidence.author: tg_jp
evidence.quote: it's not a frame number, just second of timeline position to get.

api_lessons: Animation time in the API is in seconds, not frames: doc.setAnimPosition(seconds); save doc.animPosition() first and restore it afterwards.

Read F-curves directly: obj.parameterWithName('position').takeNodeWithName(doc.currentTake().name).fCurveAtIndex(0|1|2).valueAtTime(t, 0); takeNodeWithName returns null if the parameter is not animated.
The sample calls doc.animPosition(time) with an argument, but the 8.1.1 reference signature is animPosition() with no arguments.

title: Reading material parameters
summary: Q&A: Material.rib() removed in 5.0; later the node-material JS API (6.2.1) is posted and explored, including undocumented node.id().

evidence.author: Martin
evidence.quote: that functions was removed when I introduced the new node based materials system in Cheetah3D 5.0.

evidence.author: aaronparr
evidence.quote: its not listed but i tried it and it does return a large number.

evidence.author: aaronparr
evidence.quote: the output parameter did not register as connected. but the input parameter did.

api_lessons: Material.rib() was removed in Cheetah3D 5.0 ('undefined is not a function') yet still appears in the docs (it is still listed in the 8.1.1 reference). Do not use it.
Node API: material.nodeCount()/nodeAtIndex()/rootNode()/addNodeOfType(type)/addConnection(fromID, fromPara, toID, toPara); node.inputAtIndex/outputAtIndex return Parameter objects.
node.id() is undocumented but works and returns the numeric node ID needed by Material.addConnection().
Parameter.connected() is true on the input side of a connection but false on the output side; inspect inputs to trace connections.
notes: aaronparr also asked how to assign a material to a polygon object by script; unanswered in thread.
